text_block_list.text:
A day off.
While strolling through the shopping district,
a wonderful aroma caught my attention.
A bakery sweets shop.
It smelled like freshly baked cookies.
choice_data_list: The color is nice and it looks good!

text_block_list.name: Sweets Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Hehe~,
this morning's batch came out stellar!
They're probably twice as crisp as usual!

A smile naturally formed whenever you
encountered something delightful.
Just that alone made the entire world seem
brighter.

It was a refreshing, heartwarming feeling.
If she were here,
she would surely exclaim――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mmm~, Marvelous☆ What a wonderful scent!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ohh~, wait, Trainer!

After enjoying two batches of cookies,
we took a stroll through the shopping district
together.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Those cookies! They were truly Marvelous,
weren't they?☆
And running into you makes today totally
Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I know! Trainer,
let's search for Marvelous together!
We'll explore the world and discover brand-new
Marvelous things☆★☆

Searching for Marvelous,
huh. Sounds delightful.
That brilliant world through her eyes――I
wanted to experience a piece of that
"Marvelous" worldview.
choice_data_list: I'll take you up on that offer

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All righty――!
Sharing the journey together is way more
Marvelous than going alone☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~!
Look at the bonsai in that front yard~☆

A splendid bonsai sat proudly in the
garden.
In our quest for Marvelous,
I found myself captivated by it――

text_block_list.name: Old Man A
text_block_list.text:
What are you two up to?
Got business with me?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I was just admiring how Marvelous your
bonsai is☆
Especially the curve of the trunk,
it's super Marvelous★

The old man's expression hardened.
This might be bad.
I was about to apologize for peeking into
his garden without permission, but――

text_block_list.name: Old Man A
text_block_list.text:
Little lady, you really know your stuff,
don't you……!

text_block_list.name: Old Man A
text_block_list.text:
That trunk is everything!
Took me twenty whole years to shape it like
that!
Wired it meticulously into that exact
silhouette.
choice_data_list: 20 years! That's alot of time and ...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! That is deeply Marvelous☆
You've showered it with so much loving care,
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain this bonsai grew so splendidly
just to repay all your love and
dedication!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Which means this right here is a miraculous
Marvelous☆
Witnessing such a miracle makes everyone
overwhelmingly happy and Maaarvelous★

text_block_list.name: Old Man A
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh…… it's been ages since I felt this
invigorated……
No matter how old you get,
genuine praise always warms the heart.

The old man beamed with delight.
No matter who she spoke with,
she brought out their brightest smile.
Truly Marvelous! Just as expected.

We headed toward the park for a short breather.
Spotting a young girl sitting alone on a bench,
Marvelous Sunday dashed over without
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hello there!
Are you waiting for someone? Your friends?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No…… I…… just moved here recently,
so I don't have any friends yet……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case,
I'll be your very first friend starting
right now!
Let's play!
What's a game you're really good at?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um…… hide-and-seek…… I guess.
I'm pretty good at finding people……

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ You're a master seeker, huh?★
Then hide-and-seek it is!
Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
O-okay!
Call out when both of you are hidden!

And so,
we hid ourselves and began a game of
hide-and-seek with the young girl……

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, big sister, found you!
And you're hiding right under there,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, big sister, found you!
And you're hiding right under there,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆ You found us in an instant~!
You really are a hide-and-seek champion!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
you really think so?
I'm not that amazing though…… ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're good at hide-and-seek?
Can I play with you guys too?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! If you're that good,
I wanna challenge you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, Marvelous☆
Playing with a big group is bound to be way
more fun★

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Man, you're seriously tough to beat!
Just you wait, I won't lose tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Me neither! See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
To make so many wonderful friends in just
one afternoon!
You are truly Maaaaaarvelous☆
choice_data_list: A genius at making friends too?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all thanks to you and big sister!
Um, thank you so much…… let's play again
soon!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Next time,
we'll invite even more friends!
That'll make it doubly, triply Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~~! Everything was so sparkling, lucky,
and joyful!
Just as I thought,
the entire world is overflowing with
Marvelous☆

She was the one who was truly Marvelous.
Simply by being present,
she made everything around her shine with
warmth.
Today proved that beyond a shadow of a
doubt.
choice_data_list: I think it's because of you
I think it's because of you

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Thank you!
Hearing you say that makes me super happy!
Though I think that applies just as much to
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That grandpa, that sweet little girl,
and the bakery clerk too!
Every single one of them showed a brand-new,
never-before-seen Marvelous spark!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That grandpa looked so thrilled after your
compliments, Trainer!
And that girl gained so much confidence in
herself!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Combine my Marvelous with Trainer's
Marvelous☆
Join them together, and we unlock an ultimate,
supreme Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why today was extra,
extraordinarily Marvelous!
A sparkling,
shining Marvelous like never before☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I could feel the whole world brimming with
Marvelous――
Yes, it was thoroughly,
completely Marvelous☆ Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! After all, I'm Marvelous,
so naturally my Trainer is totally Marvelous
too☆★☆

Ah, so this is it.
This is the world she sees.
I felt like I finally understood why she
pursued "Marvelous" with all her heart.

It's a good feeling. For her――no,
for the Marvelous of the world! 
I'll continue to support her!
